paths.description: Homepage and global navigation; represents landing, carousels and cross-site chrome.
Apps category listing; represents taxonomy/list templates and mobile filters.
Browse search results; represents the primary search/filter task.
App detail; represents product metadata and the download journey. Executable download was not fetched.
Contact route; chosen as the public form template, but Cloudflare returned 403.
Nonexistent route; represents HTTP failure recovery and returned a Cloudflare 403 challenge.

findings.evidence: The combined preference screenshot stays white and computed color-scheme is normal under prefers-color-scheme: dark.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and use prefers-color-scheme/light-dark() tokens for surfaces and browser chrome.

findings.summary: Core text and controls fail contrast
findings.evidence: axe reports 2.24:1 green branding, 2.58:1 gray navigation, and multiple metadata values below 4.5:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Darken green, gray, and orange text tokens to meet WCAG AA in every state.

findings.summary: Navigation and long-page movement lack modern continuity
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found no view-transition or scroll-timeline styling across page-template changes and long pages.
findings.suggestedFix: Add restrained cross-document View Transitions and preference-safe scroll-linked cues where they improve orientation.

findings.summary: Persistent chrome does not reflect scroll state
findings.evidence: The mobile header/bottom navigation remains unchanged across a 5,707px page and gives no reading/progress feedback.
findings.suggestedFix: Use scroll-state queries or a lightweight progress/location cue, respecting reduced motion.

findings.summary: Custom overlays do not use semantic top-layer primitives
findings.evidence: DOM inspection finds no dialog or popover although menu/search overlays are interactive dismissible surfaces.
findings.suggestedFix: Implement menu/search overlays with dialog or popover, invoker commands, focus containment, Escape and light dismiss.

findings.summary: Some touch targets are only 36px square
findings.evidence: The focus/size probe measured repeated collection links at 36x36px, below the recommended 44px target.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase the interactive hit area to at least 44x44 CSS px without enlarging the icon itself.

findings.summary: Failure states collapse into an unhelpful bot challenge
findings.evidence: Contact and a nonexistent URL returned Cloudflare 403 pages with no site navigation, search, retry, or return-home action.
findings.suggestedFix: Tune bot rules and provide branded 4xx/failure pages with status, retry/search, and a safe route back.

findings.summary: Resource delivery wastes bytes and blocks parsing
findings.evidence: HAR shows 1.12MB transferred, 829KB images, and synchronous jQuery plus jquery-migrate in head; 58 images lack dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Right-size/prioritize images, add intrinsic dimensions, and defer or remove parser-blocking scripts.

findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 69.4KB unused GTM and 21KB unused jQuery JavaScript on the homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove jquery-migrate/jQuery where unnecessary and load analytics only after consent/need.

findings.summary: Image-only collection links have no accessible name
findings.evidence: axe reports serious link-name failures for repeated focusable collection thumbnail links.
findings.suggestedFix: Give each link visible text or a concise aria-label tied to its destination; keep decorative images empty-alt.

findings.summary: Image markup omits dimensions and some alternatives
findings.evidence: The image audit found all 58 images without width/height and 12 without alt.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit width/height or aspect-ratio and meaningful alt for content images; use empty alt for decorative images.

findings.summary: Baseline defensive response headers are absent
findings.evidence: Headers inspection found no CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame protection, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy HSTS and nosniff first, then a measured CSP/frame-ancestors, strict referrer policy, and least-privilege permissions policy.

findings.summary: Analytics runs immediately with weak cookies
findings.evidence: Two known Google trackers load; two 400-day _ga cookies are non-Secure and SameSite=None, with no consent interaction observed.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimise analytics, gate non-essential tracking on consent, shorten retention, and set Secure with an appropriate SameSite value.

findings.evidence: html declares en-US but no dir, and CSS inspection found no logical spacing/inset properties.
findings.suggestedFix: Set an explicit direction where appropriate and replace physical layout properties with logical equivalents.

findings.evidence: The global search uses autocomplete=off and browse search has no autocomplete token.
findings.suggestedFix: Allow normal history/autofill for search unless there is a documented privacy reason to suppress it.

findings.summary: The image pipeline is substantially oversized
findings.evidence: 42/58 images are oversized, 41 use legacy formats, 11 lack srcset, and all lack dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP variants and responsive srcset/sizes, choose display-sized sources, and preserve intrinsic dimensions.

findings.summary: Third-party analytics is the largest single resource
findings.evidence: GTM transfers 169KB and is the largest request; all third-party bytes are analytics-related.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unused tags and delay a minimal analytics bundle until consent and idle/interaction.

findings.summary: Search and discovery are not exposed as agent tools
findings.evidence: The public directory has structured metadata and forms but no navigator.modelContext/WebMCP registration.
findings.suggestedFix: Expose read-only search/filter/detail capabilities as well-described WebMCP tools while retaining standard forms.

taskList.title: Repair accessible names, contrast and target sizes
Harden response headers and analytics privacy
Modernise the image and script delivery pipeline
Restore branded, recoverable HTTP/form failure states
Add user-preference and semantic overlay support
Improve navigation continuity and scroll state
Make search and layout assistance more portable
Expose safe discovery capabilities to agents
